children.text: Your data is everywhere — scattered across spreadsheets, SaaS tools, cloud platforms, and legacy databases. Most reporting tools make you jump through hoops just to bring it all together.
Dashbud makes it easy to plug in whatever you're working with:
Upload CSVs or Excel sheets

Integrate with APIs or platforms like HubSpot, Stripe, and Google Ads

Dashbud connects to spreadsheets, databases, APIs, and cloud services — no data left behind.

children.text: Creating reports from a blank screen is slow and intimidating — especially if you don’t know what’s possible or where to start.

Dashbud helps by offering smart report suggestions based on the structure of your data. It understands common use cases — like marketing attribution, product performance, or financial summaries — and suggests reports that businesses like yours typically need.
But unlike “canned” dashboards, these aren’t one-size-fits-all templates. You stay in the driver’s seat.
Want a P&L by business unit for Q1? Just ask.
Curious how revenue broke down across ad campaigns? We’ve seen that before — and we can help.
Need a customer retention snapshot for your board deck? You’re one step away.
Dashbud brings its reporting experience to your unique data — and works with you, conversationally, to shape the exact report or dashboard you need.
Dashbud suggests useful reports based on your data structure — so you don’t have to start from scratch.

children.text: Dashbud -- Privacy Policy
1. Overview

Evolytix, Inc. (“Evolytix”, “we”, “our”, or “us”) is committed to protecting your privacy and your data. This Privacy Policy describes how Dashbud collects, uses, and safeguards information when you use our platform. It also explains what we do not do — most importantly, that Dashbud does not ingest or store any of your underlying data.
2. What We Collect
When you use Dashbud, we collect only the information necessary to provide and improve our services. This includes:
User Account Information: Name, email address, organization name, and authentication credentials.
Connection Metadata: Information about the type of database you connect (e.g., SQL Server, Snowflake), including the schema, table names, column names, and data types.
Usage Logs: Activity logs related to feature usage, error reporting, and system diagnostics (all anonymized or pseudonymized wherever possible).
3. What We Do Not Collect or Store
This is important:
Dashbud does NOT ingest or store your actual business data (i.e., the records, values, or contents in your database tables).
Our platform only accesses database structure and metadata, such as:
Table names
Column names
Column types
Relationships between tables (e.g., foreign keys)
This metadata allows Dashbud to intelligently construct SQL queries based on your natural language questions — without ever exposing the underlying data to our systems or any third-party AI models.
You maintain full control of your data. Dashbud acts as a query-generation layer on top of your existing data infrastructure.
4. How We Use the Information
We use the information we collect strictly to:
Authenticate users and provide access to the Dashbud platform
Generate AI-assisted queries using your schema metadata
Improve platform performance and reliability
Provide support and troubleshoot issues
Enforce our terms and protect against abuse
We do not use your information for advertising, resell it to third parties, or allow any third-party AI models (including LLMs) to access your schema or data.
5. Security and Data Access
We implement strong technical and organizational security measures, including:
Role-based access control
Encrypted connections (TLS/SSL) for all data in transit
Logging and monitoring of access activity
Only authorized personnel may access customer-specific metadata, and only for purposes directly related to support or diagnostics.
6. Third-Party Services

Dashbud does not share any customer schema or metadata with external third-party services unless explicitly authorized by you, the customer. No analytics, ad platforms, or AI APIs process your data behind the scenes.
7. Data Retention
We retain user account data only for as long as your account remains active.
Schema metadata is retained temporarily to allow query generation but is never stored permanently unless you choose to save a dashboard or report.
You may request deletion of your account or any retained metadata at any time by contacting us.
8. Your Rights
You have the right to:
Request access to your user profile data
Request correction or deletion of your account information
Withdraw consent for optional data processing (e.g., usage analytics)
File a complaint with a regulatory authority, if applicable in your jurisdiction
9. Children’s Privacy
Dashbud is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
10. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last Updated" date. Material changes will be communicated via email or dashboard notification.
11. Contact Us
For any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: hello@mail.getdashbud.com

children.text: Dashbud lets you query your data like you're talking to a teammate. No technical syntax, no waiting in line for a report — just clear answers, fast.
Traditionally, creating a report means one of two things:
Writing SQL — which requires significant technical skill
Or slogging through a point-and-click interface in a BI tool — which is often slow, glitchy, and confusing
Dashbud removes both barriers. You simply ask a question — and Dashbud generates accurate, visual answers on the fly. For example:
“What were our top-selling products last week?”
“Show me revenue by ad campaign for Q2.”
“What’s our gross margin for last month compared to the same month last year?”
By making reporting conversational, Dashbud gives business teams instant access to the answers they need — and frees up analysts to focus on deeper work.
Ask questions in natural language and get answers in real time — no SQL, no middleman.

children.text: Cookie Policy
1. Introduction
This Cookie Policy explains how
Dashbud

(“we”, “our”, “us”) uses cookies and similar technologies on our website and platform.
It describes what these technologies are, why we use them, and how you can manage your preferences.
2. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser.
They allow websites to remember information about your visit, such as login status, preferences, or analytics data.
We also use similar technologies (e.g., localStorage) where needed for functionality.
3. How We Use Cookies
We group cookies into the same categories you see in our consent banner:
Strictly Necessary
Required for core site functions (e.g., security, session management). They are always enabled.
Analytics

Help us understand how visitors use Dashbud so we can improve performance and usability.
For example: Google Analytics (through Google Tag Manager).
Ads & Tracking

Used to measure ad performance or remarketing campaigns (e.g., Google Ads, LinkedIn).
We don’t currently run large-scale ad tracking, but we keep this category for future use.
We don’t sell your data or use third-party advertising networks without consent.
4. Your Choices
When you first visit Dashbud, you’ll see a banner allowing you to:
Accept all cookies
Reject non-essential cookies
Manage preferences
(choose Analytics and/or Ads individually)
You can update your preferences anytime by selecting
“Update cookie preferences”

in our site footer.
Your choices are remembered in your browser until you clear them or reset via that link.
5. Managing Cookies in Your Browser

Most browsers let you block or delete cookies entirely.
If you do so, essential site functions may stop working (e.g., login sessions).
See browser help pages for instructions:
Chrome
Firefox
Safari
Edge
6. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy to reflect changes in technology, regulation, or our practices.
Material updates will be highlighted in the banner or via a notice on this page.
7. Contact Us
If you have questions about our use of cookies or how to manage them, contact us at: hello [at] mail.getdashbud.com
